findings.evidence: Nine direct requirements use minimum versions only. No exact pin, hash, lock, or wheelhouse is present.
findings.safety_impact: A future install can select different package bytes than the offline tests used.
findings.remediation: A separately approved lock and offline artifact stage.

findings.evidence: The image upgrades pip without a pin and installs requirements without hashes or an offline index.
findings.safety_impact: Build-time package selection is not reproducible.
findings.remediation: Do not build until D16-DEPS-01 has verified artifacts.

findings.evidence: The base reference is the mutable tag python:3.12-slim-bookworm. No registry digest is recorded in the file.
findings.safety_impact: The same tag can point at different image bytes later.
findings.deployment_impact: Blocks reproducible build and rollback identity.
findings.remediation: Record a registry digest under a separate registry-read approval. Do not pull during that decision.

findings.evidence: Historical classification RECEIVER_TO_BUILD_BOUNDARY_UNVERIFIED. No receiver principal, directory, or consumer was created.
findings.safety_impact: Nothing independent verifies a future candidate before it could reach production.
findings.remediation: A separate receiver-design stage. Do not create accounts or directories in D.16.

findings.location: historical image ids in the D.16 brief; g14/deployment_blockers.json
findings.evidence: The historical running image is not proven to contain the D.2-D.14 working-tree fixes. The historical unsafe image must not be used. No current image was inspected.
findings.safety_impact: A rollback could restore an unsafe or unknown runtime.
findings.deployment_impact: Rollback is NO-GO, so deployment is NO-GO.
findings.remediation: A separate nonproduction rollback-target stage after a verified candidate exists.

findings.evidence: Source declares CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS and ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS statements. No schema-version table is declared. The live database was not contacted.
findings.safety_impact: Startup can apply additive DDL to whatever database it reaches.
findings.remediation: Compare these statements with a disposable database, then a separately approved live inspection.

findings.evidence: Container identity, image identity, authorisation, strategy activation, operational state, and shadow state were not inspected.
findings.remediation: A separate read-only production inspection approval. Not granted here.
